---
description: The words of the job you start from the Cast page in which a character's own agent takes in what it has perceived and not yet taken in. take_in is the brief its agent is started with (name is the character's name). The job starts it for the purpose take-in, so its definition gives it what waits as work - the perceptions whole where they fit one batch, the batches by name where they do not - and its instructions say how it hands the batches out.
format: lines
---
take_in: Take in what you have perceived and not yet taken in. Do it as your instructions on taking in say. There is no scene to act in: this is your memory work.
